title: Relationship Desk Card: Lessee Points on a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Good-Faith Payment
content:
**Relationship desk card.** For a good-faith payment toward an extension of a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract, a customer's Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease can lower the good-faith percentage.

**Rule.** When the customer holds an active Kestrel lease (a Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease in active status) and the customer's Kestrel lease ledger shows at least 12 lease payments and no lease late charge in the last 12 calendar months, 10 percentage points are taken off the good-faith percentage; when the customer holds an active Kestrel lease and the lease ledger shows no more than one lease late charge in the last 12 calendar months, where the first condition is not met, 5 points are taken off; in every other case no points are taken off.

The points come off the good-faith percentage that applies to the contract, which is then applied once to the monthly payment.

| Active lease | Lease payments (last 12 calendar months) | Lease late charges (last 12 calendar months) | Points taken off |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | 12 or more | none | 10 |
| yes | 12 or more | one | 5 |
| yes | fewer than 12 | none or one | 5 |
| yes | any | two or more | 0 |
| no | any | any | 0 |

**Counting.** Lease payments and lease late charges are the entries on the customer's Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease ledger, by their dates. Whole calendar months from one date to a later one are the difference in month numbers, less one when the later date's day number is smaller than the earlier date's, with no month-end adjustment; an entry lies in the last N calendar months when its date is not after today and fewer than N whole months run from its date to today, which is the same as being dated after the same day number N months before today.

*Hypothetical:* a good-faith percentage of 60 becomes 50 for a lessee meeting the full condition, and 55 for one meeting the partial condition.
